findings: An indwelling right pleural catheter (e.g., PleurX) is present. The internal fenestrated portion coils in the right lower pleural space. The external hub and tubing project over the right mid-chest, secured by superimposed external objects (including what appears to be a safety pin and clip attached to clothing/dressing).

Patchy radiopacities are present in the right mid and lower lung zones, with obscuration of the right costophrenic angle and hemidiaphragm. This likely represents residual pleural effusion, pleural thickening, and/or basilar atelectasis.
The left lung is clear of focal consolidation, large pleural effusion, or pneumothorax.
The cardiac silhouette is mildly enlarged.
The mediastinal and hilar contours are otherwise unremarkable.
Orthopedic hardware consisting of an intramedullary nail with proximal locking screws is visualized in the right humerus.
